items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I picked the reed section up in my car... Sterling, not reedy, sterling. You're next.

ctx.x: If one had a car, he was going to put some gas, everybody chip in and put gas in it. I picked the reed section up in my car, and they put gas in it to come to

rehearsal so we could rehearse together the reed section, but it made a good band, being with this loyalty to one another, and like a family and respected one another, and we had a good band. Sterling, not reedy, sterling. You're next.
Now -- yeah, one thing. You know we've mentioned Joe Thomas several times, and you said that (inaudible). Of course, you don't really sound alike in a sense. You both have a lot of drive but --
